label: Search runtime query monitoring API
type: the REST endpoint (GET /api/query) listing currently-running Search queries, filterable by fts:longerthan-parameter. First named in fts-monitor.md (round 23) via the Web Console UI equivalent; this round supplies the REST-first-hand definition.
relates_to_competency_question: Can an administrator see which Search queries are currently running and filter to just the slow ones?
evidence: Use the View Active Index Queries API or the View Active Node Queries API to get the parameters `queryID` and `uuid`, which are used to identify and cancel the query.
The Search Service REST port. Use 18094 for secure access.
